QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_17

question.text: The maximum number of investors permissible in one scheme of a Cat III AIF is (excluding Accredited Investors who are EXCLUDED from the count):

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the CTR row on investor count, an AIF cannot have more than 1,000 investors in a single scheme. Accredited Investors are EXCLUDED from the count (Third Amendment Regulations 2021 context). 49 is the private-placement cap under the Companies Act (different framework). 200 is PMS threshold conceptually. The Trap: 49 is Companies-Act private-placement. 200 is PMS context. 500 is a distractor. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C / XIX-D test the 1,000-investor cap across categories. XXI-B (Portfolio Managers) does not have the same cap.
